title: Open-Meteo geocoding — Big Bear Lake, California, United States
claims: Open-Meteo geocoding returns Big Bear Lake, San Bernardino County, California at latitude 34.2439, longitude -116.91142, elevation 2,058 m.
The result is a town centroid, not the Rim Nordic Ski Area start or the Village finish line.

verification.note: 2026-11-09 调用 Open-Meteo geocoding API，取 Big Bear Lake 镇中心坐标作地图锚点。

claimVerification.note: API 返回 latitude 34.2439、longitude -116.91142、elevation 2058.0、feature_code PPL、admin2 San Bernardino
